If you've been married for more than two years, you cannot file for an annulment; you must instead file for a divorce if you choose to proceed down this path. This scenario is often referred to as "the seven-year itch," where a spouse cannot file for divorce based on a technicality (the length of the marriage) but chooses to instead highlight that a marriage has only lasted seven years. This situation is often symbolic of frustration with their current partner due to repeated marital dissolution. 

However, there are some other options as well. You could consider seeking counseling to try to resolve the issues within your marriage or find ways to make living apart from your spouse more bearable
